blocks.text: INGLEWOOD, California — Darius Garland scored 27 points, Max Strus had 14 off the bench and the Los Angeles Clippers beat the Charlotte Hornets for the 17th straight time with a 113-105 victory Sunday. Derrick Jones Jr. and Isaiah Jackson each scored 13 points, while Keaton Wagler and Gradey Dick had 12 apiece as the Clippers overcame a 13-point deficit in the third quarter to win for the third time in four games following a 1-7 start. Coby White scored 21 points and Naz Reid added 17 for the Hornets, who lost for the eighth time in their past nine games […]...
